product_name: ICICI Pru Guaranteed Pension Plan Flexi
description: A retirement plan that provides a guaranteed annuity for life, with options to choose from various annuity payout frequencies and deferment periods. The plan also offers a return of premium option, joint life annuity options, and increasing annuity options to help individuals secure their retirement income.

Option to choose premium payment term from 2 to 15 years
Option to receive return of premium on death or critical illness
Option to choose joint life annuity with spouse, child, parent, or sibling
Option to choose increasing annuity with 5% annual increase
